# opnsense_caddy_access_list (Data Source)

Reads a Caddy access list by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_caddy_access_list" "management" {
  id = var.access_list_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the access list.

### Read-Only

- `client_ips` (Set of String)
- `description` (String)
- `http_response_code` (Number)
- `http_response_message` (String)
- `invert` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `request_matcher` (String)
